translated_title: Sheinbaum Foresees 12 Million Families Benefited by the Housing Program by the End of Her Government
original_title: Sheinbaum prevé que al final de su gobierno haya 12 millones de familias beneficiadas con programa de vivienda
author: Emir Olivares and Lilian Hernández
meta_description: The housing-for-well-being program will add 1.2% of GDP a year and four jobs per home; 600,000 homes are already contracted, generating 2.4 million jobs.
